# Feature: Mirror block — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #84 (Mirror block) from Blocks before it is used in real levels. Effect: turns enemies that hit it. Unique: edits enemy paths instead of blocking the player. Useful: redirects a patroller away from your corridor. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** turns enemies that hit it.

**So that** redirects a patroller away from your corridor.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Mirror block for the first time in its teaching room (mech-84-mirror-block-room). Teaching moment: First room: a patroller crosses your corridor and the mirror block starts one tile off the useful spot. A player who leaves it there sees the patroller reverse into their corridor instead of away from it and is reset to the room start, which teaches that the mirror changes an enemy's route rather than merely blocking it. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: It moves only onto empty floor or a switch plate, exactly as a push block (81)
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Water, deep water, void, fire and lava block it; it never enters or covers them
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: An enemy that moves into it reverses direction instead of passing, so it edits a patroller loop without touching the player

## Edge Cases & Rules

- It moves only onto empty floor or a switch plate, exactly as a push block (81)
- Water, deep water, void, fire and lava block it; it never enters or covers them
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Mirror block's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-84-mirror-block-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/blocks.yml mechanic #84.
